content:
Webb County closed early voting with 46,332 ballots cast through Friday, October 30, the final day of the early-voting period, according to KGNS, citing totals released by the Webb County Elections Administration.

The total includes 45,483 in-person ballots and 849 mail-in ballots. The final day alone produced 6,130 votes — 6,089 in person across 12 polling locations plus 41 mail-in ballots — the highest single-day turnout of the two-week period, according to the report.

The first week, October 19–23, produced 20,637 votes, and voting on October 24–25 added 5,701 more. The second week added 19,994 votes through Friday. The busiest location over the period was the Laredo Fire Department administrative site, with 13,864 in-person voters.

Early voting is now over; the Nov. 3 joint general election is next for voters who did not cast a ballot early.

Sources:

  • KGNS, "Final day of early voting pushes Webb County turnout past 46,000," October 30, 2026

title: Webb County closes early voting with 46,332 ballots as final day sets the period's high mark
